summary: Transglobal Management Group filed an 8-K reporting termination of its asset purchase agreement with Dalston LLP for the Apache Creek Golf Course in Arizona. The company failed to secure financing and could not restructure terms; seller retained the $200,000 deposit, recognized as a loss. No deal terms beyond the deposit were disclosed. No board recommendation or advisors named. The termination resolves the acquisition risk; watch for potential seller claims or future acquisition attempts.
